svg.text: Entity-Relationship Diagram (Core System Functions & User Roles)
UKonek_Plus Live Schema · 19 Core Public Tables · 35 Enforced FKs (solid) · 5 Implied Non-FK Links (dashed) · All 6 User Roles Covered
admin (staff CRUD, login logs, schedules, inventory delete, reports) · doctor (consultations, lab_orders, prescriptions, triage/queue, announcements)
nurse (triage vital_signs, queue tickets, consultation vitals & lab updates, medicine stock) · pharmacist (medicines, Rx dispenses, OTC dispenses, returns)
citizen (profile, queue tickets, own clinical/Rx records, medicine_intake_logs, feedbacks) · anon (OTP signup via pending_citizen_signups, TV queue, public announcements)
